transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been feeling really depressed and sad, and it just isn't going away. This heavy, down mood has been constant for about two years and four months now. I just felt like I finally needed to seek some help for it.

I'm sorry to hear you've been carrying this heavy mood for so long. Have you ever had periods lasting a few days or more where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, high, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. It's really only been this low, depressed mood the entire time. I've never had periods of high energy or feeling "high."
Along with this low mood, have you also been struggling with constant, excessive worry or anxiety about various everyday things that you find difficult to control?
No, I haven't really been experiencing constant or excessive worry. It doesn't feel like anxiety, just a very heavy and down mood.
During this period of over two years, have you ever had a time lasting more than two months where you felt completely back to your normal self, free from this low mood?

No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. This low mood has been completely continuous for the entire two years and four months. I haven't had a single period of two months or more where I felt back to my normal self.
Besides the low mood, have you noticed other changes, such as losing interest in things you used to enjoy, or changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels?

Yes, I've definitely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love, and it feels impossible to experience any happiness or pleasure lately. However, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels.
How has your self-esteem been during this time, and have you found it difficult to concentrate or make everyday decisions?

I'm not really sure about my self-esteem, and I haven't noticed any major problems with concentrating or making decisions. It's more that I just have absolutely no motivation to do anything because of this constant low mood.
During this long period of low mood, have you experienced feelings of hopelessness, or felt like things will never get better?
I'm not quite sure if I would call it hopelessness, and I haven't really thought about it in those terms. It's more that I just feel completely empty, sad, and emotionally flat most of the time.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, or feeling excessively guilty about things that might not even be your fault?
No, I haven't really experienced feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt. I don't tend to blame myself or feel that way at all.
